_doc: Stale->fresh CSS-module hash map after the 2026-10-23 DSH rebuild. Entries marked 'pkg:' were judged by module identity (old-dump region comment -> owning package), not just suffix sets. Regenerate candidates with node tools/rehash.mjs (dry run).
_comment3: Digit-leading hashes emit the byte form with a leading dash: zpy3TW (TerminalGuide) became -4GESq (stylesheet `.-\34 GESq_entry`, JS value "-4GESq_entry"). Recorded so the next dry run agrees with pages.css.
_comment2: True byte forms (leading _N where the build emits them): r0rkG=_9r0rkG, KfHza=_1KfHza, zXc5G=_3zXc5G, qcDqa=_6qcDqa, R73eq=_3R73eq, EiRdG=_4EiRdG, Qcc8a=_5Qcc8a, qxJPq=_7qxJPq. cS6V_W and CDP_Dq genuinely contain an internal underscore and have no leading _N; they are self-mapped so rehash.mjs (whose candidate regex cannot see them) treats them as resolved.
